approaches.name: Bounded mass redistribution
approaches.detail: balanced_hands_v1 moves 0.190 kg from fingers to pelvis/spine, preserves total 1.829753 kg and collision geometry.

approaches.name: Learned periodic gait with balance feedback
approaches.status: 5 m milestone passed: 6.494 m in 45 s
approaches.detail: Exact checkpoint passed both standing rechecks, 47 left/48 right swings, no fall/reset. Joint speed 3.30 rad/s, peak force 2.86 body weights. Full proof video attached.

approaches.name: Robust gait search
approaches.status: Six cumulative milestones certified; paused by user
approaches.detail: Bounded parameter search over a learned gait and frozen standing PPO. Each candidate is checked in four starting states; milestone promotion requires an independent exact-checkpoint run and cumulative proof videos.

approaches.name: Command response and restart training
approaches.detail: Learned left/right corrections, restart ramp/phase and per-stop memory passed independent evaluation. Separate right-turn hold feedback preserves the certified left-turn behavior. The exact checkpoint re-passed M1–M5 with reviewed videos.

approaches.name: Standing PPO transferred to walking
approaches.detail: Corrected action units and frozen normalization, then tested exploration, hip-roll range and tilt reward. Candidates stayed near standing or regressed.

approaches.name: Fresh walking PPO with frozen standing branch
approaches.detail: Independent fresh moving actor with physical observation scaling retained the trained zero-command standing controller.

approaches.name: Actuator-only support diagnostics
approaches.detail: Hip-roll preloads and leg-shortening pulses exposed support transitions and tipping. Scripted diagnostics are not trained-policy passes.

approaches.name: Residual PPO around a verified gait
approaches.status: Candidate after a robust gait is verified
approaches.detail: Use the learned feedback gait as a starting controller for command tracking and balance corrections.

approaches.name: Retargeted motion imitation
approaches.detail: Requires a collision-clear reference compatible with the character proportions and actuator limits.

approaches.name: Whole-body control or trajectory optimization
approaches.detail: Generate feasible support transitions and foot-placement targets before policy learning.

approaches.name: Physical randomization
approaches.detail: Small mass, friction and gain variations after nominal acceptance; any changed nominal model requires fresh standing certification.

approaches.name: Verified G1 training baseline
approaches.detail: G1 fresh training and evaluation have their own checkpoints, timing and videos; they do not count as Landau milestone passes.
